verdict.rationale: The published pages describe online quarterly filing only through an EAMS account reached by logging into SecureAccess Washington, and they point users without an account to account-setup guidance. The probe found that the transactional host sends every keyless request to a login wall. No keyless or file-number entry path to the online flow is documented; the paper-form alternative is not an online flow and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start the core online flow without creating an account first — the service's published pages document a keyless or file-number entry path
